description: Reviewed semantic classifications for individual records whose legacy Growth Zone identifies a Method or Lens rather than a concrete Topic. These overrides supplement, not replace, the legacy Method/Lens classification.

90-30-focus-rest-schedule.reason: The effective protocol alternates focused work with real breaks. Attention & Focus describes the work phase; Recovery & Energy describes the break/recovery phase. Antifragility remains a Lens.

triz-contradiction-coach.reason: The action uses contradiction templates to frame and solve problems. TRIZ remains the Method.

chef-taste-and-adjust.reason: The entry explicitly generalizes taste-judge-adjust-repeat into regular review and refinement of projects and tasks. Chef / Operations remains the Lens.

counterbalance-intense-activities-for-st.reason: The concrete action is to balance intense activity with lower-intensity or opposite activity to manage recovery and load. TRIZ remains the Method.

detective-mnemonic-memory-tricks.reason: The entry creates memory aids for observations. Detective remains the Lens.

hobby-diversification-tracker.reason: The concrete practice is to develop unfamiliar hobbies and skills outside the user's usual activity pattern. Antifragility remains a Lens rather than the Topic.

circles-of-control-planner.reason: The curated protocol separates controllable from uncontrollable factors to allocate action and reduce wasted effort under stress. Stoicism remains a Lens.

home-privacy-planner.reason: The action changes physical space to create privacy and solitude. This is broader than Workspace and belongs to Environment Design. Architecture remains a Lens.

spot-overlooked-details.reason: The action deliberately inspects small observations that may alter an interpretation or reveal an avoidable issue. Detective remains a Lens.

safety-statements-exposure-anxiety.reason: The reviewed protocol is graded facing of a manageable fear. Exposure remains the sensitive Method; Fear & Confidence is the user-facing Topic.

qa-feedback-loop-tracker.reason: The practice creates a recurring feedback-and-improvement loop for work. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-test-case-coverage-planner.reason: Test-case coverage is used to anticipate scenarios and prevent missed failures. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-workspace-organizer.reason: The practice organizes the work/testing environment to reduce friction and mistakes. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-severity-priority-coach.reason: The action ranks issues by severity and priority before acting. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

qa-checklist-templates-runbook.reason: The practice uses reusable checklists/runbooks to prevent omissions in recurring work. Quality Assurance remains a Lens.

read-the-room-trainer.reason: The entry observes tone, posture and other signals, treats interpretations as hypotheses, and uses low-risk follow-up questions. Fieldcraft remains a Lens.

repurpose-resources-save-time.reason: The action reframes existing resources for a new use to solve a constraint with less waste. TRIZ remains the Method.

reverse-thinking-triz.reason: The action deliberately reverses a normal assumption or approach to generate alternative solutions. TRIZ remains the Method.

ergonomic-workspace-assessment.reason: The entry changes a physical workspace for comfort and efficiency. Workspace captures the work context; Environment Design captures the physical-space dimension. Architecture remains a Lens.

pause-before-reacting-three-breaths-stoi.reason: The Stoic pause creates a short gap before reacting so the user can choose a response rather than act impulsively. Stoicism remains a Lens.

smart-home-roi-planner.reason: The entry evaluates and iterates technology that changes the physical environment, with explicit friction, privacy, cost and routine trade-offs. Architecture remains a Lens.

3-minute-sensory-mindfulness-act.reason: The reviewed practice uses sensory attention to return to the present and notice experience without claiming a universal treatment effect. ACT remains the sensitive Method.

stoic-acceptance-tracker.reason: The concrete practice is to acknowledge a difficult reality, reduce resistance, and choose a workable next action. Stoicism remains a Lens.
